Incident Bot: ALERT triggered: log.alerts.high_500_rate · severity=page · threshold=0.8
Incident Bot: link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1717604321 · runbook: /runbooks/high-5xx-rate
Maya Patel: @oncall we're getting a spike in 5xxs from api-gateway in eu-west-1, customers complaining via support. seeing ~900 reqs/min with 2.3% 5xx (baseline 0.1%). paging now.
Devon Liu: I'm on it, taking the bridge. starting probe to check recent deploys and infra.
Sloan Park: quick note — traffic pattern shows sustained prefix /v1/generate with long tail latencies. likely a cache cascade.
Anika Romero: can you paste the query you used for the alert? want to check noisy sources.
Maya Patel: alert query (splunk-ish):
```
index=prod_logs service=api-gateway status>=500 | timechart span=1m count by status | eval error_rate = count(status=500)/count(total) | where error_rate > 0.008
```
Maya Patel: current hits:
- 500: 18k in last 10m
- 502: 420 in last 10m
- 504: 2.1k in last 10m
Devon Liu: looks like 504s concentrated on hosts rwd-gw-6-*. I'm seeing increased backend timeouts to model-inference.
Ops SRE: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep crash` — nothing obvious, but node rwd-node-12 shows OOMs earlier.
Sloan Park: can we quickly suppress noisy 504s from a known load-test job? I think infra-tests generate 504s with header `x-test-run: true`.
Maya Patel: propose add temporary filter to reduce pages: `NOT headers.x-test-run:true` or a regex excluding `pipeline=test-.*`. Only as a live mitigation; will follow up permanent rule later.
Anika Romero: agree. Also propose reducing sensitivity: bump threshold from 0.008 -> 0.015 for 15m window to avoid pagers while we triage.
Devon Liu: I can push a live mitigation:
```
AlertRule update: log.alerts.high_500_rate
- add filter: "NOT headers.x-test-run:true"
- set window=15m
- set threshold=0.015
```
Devon Liu: applying now (will annotate change in alert history).
Incident Bot: AlertRule change recorded by Devon Liu — id=ar-88231 — annotation: temporary suppression for test-run noise.
Maya Patel: after suppression, pages dropped, but customer-impactful 504s still present for genuine traffic. we need targeted rule update to avoid suppressing real issues.
Sloan Park: suggestion: add regex signature for known benign stacktraces that occur during deploys — e.g., `java.lang.IllegalStateException: .*deploy.*` — exclude from rule.
Anika Romero: let's craft a safer query:
```
index=prod_logs service=api-gateway status=504
| where not match(headers.user_agent, "(?i)test-run|internal-monitor")
| where not match(message, "java.lang.IllegalStateException: .*deploy.*")
| stats count() by host
| where count > 50
```
Maya Patel: that looks good. also add a tag `suppress:temp` to excluded events so they still appear in logs for postmortem.
Devon Liu: rolling this as a staged rollout: apply to non-prod first, then eu-west-1 infra, then global. will run a canary for 5 minutes.
Ops SRE: dashboard request — please add a panel showing `5xx by host (last 1h)`, `top 10 endpoints by 5xx` and `requests with headers.x-test-run` so we can validate suppression is only catching tests.
Sloan Park: noted, I'll create the dashboard and share link. will include latency heatmap and KV cache hit ratio for inference services.
Anika Romero: follow-ups for post-incident:
- convert temp regex into a signature with explicit whitelist (owner: eng-infra)
- run synthetic tests to ensure suppression doesn't hide regressions
- add a metric-based fallback alert (p95 latency > 3s) so we don't rely only on log signatures
Maya Patel: Customer impact summary for SOC: ~120 customers experienced intermittent errors over 14m window, main cause increased backend timeouts to inference service due to noisy cache eviction. Support notified: ticket #CS-4120.
Devon Liu: root cause hypothesis: cache eviction storm + one overloaded inference host causing cascading timeouts. mitigation: scale inference replica pool + tune cache TTL.
Ops SRE: I'll open infra ticket with priority P1 for auto-scaling config and node reprovisioning.
Incident Bot: Bridge closed by Devon Liu · duration 45m · summary recorded to /incidents/1717604321/postmortem-draft.md
Maya Patel: adding required follow-up owners: Eng-Infra (cache tuning), Eng-Serving (model replica autoscale), Monitoring (convert temp suppression to proper signature).
Sloan Park: leaving final note — please avoid permanent threshold jumps; we must instrument to find signal sources first. :eyes:
Anika Romero: thumbs up. I'll draft postmortem and link dashboards.
Maya Patel: thanks team. closing thread here; will ping when postmortem ready. :white_check_mark:
